title: Research questions and evaluation plan
author: Faye Niu
format: portrait-width LaTeX table with plain-text alternative
source_note: Developed by the author from the fixed evaluation plan and current evidence status. It does not add a study result.

condition_map.C0: Authorised practitioner completes the manual workflow under the frozen input and source-access window.
condition_map.C1: Fixed automated workflow using the same cases and information access but without a separate verifier.
condition_map.C2: The same fixed workflow with a separate verifier controlling claim-support eligibility.
condition_map.C3: C2 output followed by named human review, edit, approval or rejection.

evidence_boundary.d0: Executable synthetic engineering regression and mechanism evidence; not evidence of real portfolio performance.
evidence_boundary.d1: Authorised pilot/calibration evidence is held pending protocol, authority and freeze requirements.
evidence_boundary.d2: Final out-of-sample evidence is sealed and held; it has no accessible path or checksum in the application.
evidence_boundary.manual_and_human: C0 manual and C3 reviewer observations are EVIDENCE HELD / NO-GO until ethics/data authority, a frozen reference and authorised participation exist.
excluded: live public-web company-research evaluation outside RQ1--RQ3

locators: Implemented case study and held future evaluation
inputs.role: current primary question, RQ1-RQ3 wording and exclusion of live public-web evaluation
workflow-level evaluand, fair comparison boundary and non-production contribution
condition definitions, observable measures, data-tier status and authorisation boundaries
typed, temporal, provenance, verification and named-review observables
implemented mechanism contracts and explicit separation of D0 from held human/live evidence

row_traceability.evaluand: The combined findings for RQ1 to RQ3 across C0 manual work, C1 and C2 automation, and C3 named review
row_traceability.status: D0 tests C1/C2 mechanisms only; C0, C3, D1 and D2 are on hold, so the primary question is partly answered

row_traceability.evaluand: Apply fixed identity, date, missing-data and source rules to labelled cases and compare the output with agreed reference answers
row_traceability.status: D0 provides labelled mechanism evidence; D1 and sealed D2 are held, so no real-portfolio accuracy is established
source_locators: DATA_DICTIONARY Missing-state taxonomy and Period semantics

row_traceability.evaluand: Compare C1 without a separate verifier with C2 on the same cases and with the same information access
row_traceability.status: C1 and C2 have been compared on D0; D1 and D2 are held, so the result does not establish performance on new company data

row_traceability.evaluand: Compare manual C0, automated C1 and C2, and named-review C3 on the same tasks, sources and reference answers
row_traceability.status: No C0 or C3 observations exist; the authorised human comparison is on hold, so RQ3 is unanswered
